events.title: the Ch'yrwmmhyre begin an interstellar civilization
events.description: The Decapodis Sepiidi-charm (Ch'yrwmmhyre), originating in the NGC 188 FTS 252 system, begin sustained interstellar civilization. Their aquatic technological origins and isolation high above the Galactic plane make later development unusually difficult.

events.title: the Ch'yrwmmhyre remain outside the Involved during the Idiran–Culture War
events.description: They are an interstellar civilization by this period but are not counted among the Involved during the war.

events.title: first to-plane ships enter service using near-exclusive infra-space travel
events.description: A major propulsion breakthrough gives Ch'yrwmmhyre vessels practical to-plane capability based almost entirely on infra-space.

events.title: the Ch'yrwmmhyre become an Involved civilization
events.description: Further travel breakthroughs finally overcome much of the isolation imposed by their location and technological history, allowing them to operate at the level of the Galactic Involved.

events.title: the Ch'yrwmmhyre join the Culture's Ulterior from outside the Culture
events.description: They become the first externally originating civilization in this chronology to join the Culture's Ulterior rather than arising as a splinter from the Culture proper.
